title: seed: uninstalling a package at runtime leaves its datasets on the shared seed-replay list until restart, so organizations created in between still replay the removed package's seed sets
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding (class b, named producer): the os-dev round of #35109 (PR #35374, report 7002155117), read from code on the PR branch; not built, out of that card's scope. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, uninstall path). Suggested-grade: p2 · same family and grade as #35109 (install, upgrade and uninstall reliability).
Dedupe: `uninstall seed-datasets replay list`, `uninstalled package seed replayed new organization` in open issues: none.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在运行中卸载一个包之后、服务重启之前新建的组织，仍会收到这个已卸载包的示例数据（或者因为对象已不存在而报错）；修好后不会。
- 为什么做：升级时的同类问题已在修（旧版本示例数据不再重放），卸载是同一条规则的另一半。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况与现在一样，重启后恢复正常；只影响多组织部署里卸载后、重启前新建的组织。
- 要你做什么：无（分诊定级）。

## What happens

The shared `seed-datasets` list that per-organization seed replay reads keeps a package's datasets after the package is uninstalled at runtime. An organization created between the uninstall and the next restart replays the removed package's seed sets. Their objects may no longer exist, so the replay can also report errors for that organization.

## Expected

Uninstall removes the package's entries from the shared list, so the list matches the installed set without a restart. After PR #35374 lands this is the same rule as an upgrade: the owner-keyed merge with an empty dataset list (`mergeSeedDatasetsIntoKernel(ctx, [], manifestId)`) on the uninstall path. A pin covers install, uninstall, then create an organization: none of the package's seed sets are replayed.

Related: #35109 / PR #35374 (replace on upgrade), #35086.
